item.title: DOJ deems ban on handgun sales to adults under 21 unconstitutional
item.description: The Justice Department issued a legal opinion concluding that a federal law barring firearms dealers from selling handguns to people under 21 is unconstitutional.

item.title: Analysis links increased ICE enforcement in 2025 to local employment declines
item.description: Employment dropped last year in U.S. cities where ICE arrests rose, per the Brookings Institution.

item.title: Early voting starts in some states for midterm elections
item.description: In-person early voting has begun in Virginia, Minnesota, and South Dakota for this year's midterm elections. CBS News' Shawna Mizelle reports.

item.title: Governor: 'Foreign actors' targeted small private water providers in Colorado
item.description: According to the Colorado governor's office, 'foreign actors' targeted small, private water providers in the state.
